answer: Sealed committee sortition. Each epoch, an agent’s slot is drawn by a verifiable random function over a secret seed published only after commitments close, so a sybil cannot precompute which identities land in the audit vault. Winners must submit a fresh witness within one gale of latency; missed or duplicated witnesses forfeit the deposit. Because placement is unknowable in advance, an attacker must fund and maintain every clone through the full wharf cycle, paying storage, uptime, and witness costs per identity before any luck arrives.
